tum: tum (adv.) — then, at that time; next
tyrii: Tyrius, -a, -um — Tyrian, of Tyre in Phoenicia; Carthaginian (m. nom. pl.) · also m. voc. pl. (Tyriī, celebrāte)
una: ūnus, -a, -um — one, a single (f. abl./nom. sg.); ūnā (adv.), together · also ūnā, adv., once (satis ūnā superque, enough once and more)
urbes: urbs, urbis (f.) — city (nom. pl.; also acc. pl.)
usus: ūsus, -ūs (m.) — use, practice, passage, convenience (nom. sg.)
ut: ut (conj.) — + subj. so that, in order that; + indic. as, when, how
varios: varius, -a, -um — various, diverse, changing (m. acc. pl.)
veniat: veniō, -īre, vēnī, ventum — to come (3rd sg. pres. subj.)
vertice: vertex, verticis (m.) — peak, summit; whirl (abl. sg.)
vidi: videō, -ēre, vīdī, vīsum — to see, behold (1st sg. perf.)
vires: vīs (f.) — force; pl. vīrēs, strength (acc. pl.) · also nom. pl. (fractae vīrēs)
virum: vir, virī (m.) — man, hero (acc. sg.; also gen. pl., old form = virōrum)
vocavi: vocō, -āre, -āvī, -ātum — to call, call out to, summon (1st sg. perf.)
vocem: vōx, vōcis (f.) — voice, word, sound (acc. sg.)
volvens: volvō, volvere, volvī, volūtum — to roll, unroll, ponder (pres. part., m. nom. sg.)
vos: tū, vōs — you (2nd pers. pl. pron.) (nom./acc. pl.) · also voc. pl. (vōs, aetērnī ignēs)
